# Workaway

> > Workaway is a cultural exchange platform connecting travelers with hosts worldwide for volunteer opportunities in exchange for food and accommodation.

The platform enables gap year travelers, digital nomads, and cultural exchange seekers to find meaningful volunteer experiences across countries including New Zealand, Australia, Peru, France, Germany, Canada, Thailand, and many others. Workaway facilitates working holidays, house-sitting, pet-sitting, and community-based volunteer projects.

## Key Topics

- Cultural exchange
- Volunteer travel
- Working holidays
- Gap year opportunities
- House-sitting
- Pet-sitting
- Host-volunteer matching
- Travel community
- Food and accommodation exchange
- International volunteering
- Sustainable travel
- Skills exchange
- Farm stays
- Language learning
- Budget travel

## Platform Overview

- [Workaway - Cultural Exchange Platform](https://www.workaway.info/?ref=www.invitation.app): Homepage for Workaway, the leading cultural exchange platform connecting gap year travelers and volunteers with hosts worldwide for food and accommodation exchanges
